description: Source code for ATM driver core functions specific to the AR9 platform, including hardware initialization, firmware version retrieval, and control operations.

methods.name: ar9_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the major and minor firmware version numbers.

methods.name: ar9_init
methods.description: Initializes hardware components for AR9 platform.

methods.name: ar9_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down hardware components for AR9 platform.

methods.name: ar9_start
methods.description: Starts firmware execution on the AR9 platform.

methods.name: ar9_stop
methods.description: Stops firmware execution on the AR9 platform.
